description: This file defines an Android Fragment class 'CustomTransitionFragment' which manages multiple scenes and applies custom transitions between them. It handles scene setup, state preservation, and user interaction to cycle through scenes with custom animations.

classes.name: CustomTransitionFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that manages scene transitions with a custom animation in response to user interaction.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout from XML.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes scene objects, sets up the custom transition, and displays the initial scene.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current scene index to preserve state across configuration changes.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click events to cycle to the next scene with a transition.
